notes.title: 2023/3/26 major update notice
notes.content:
[h2]New achievements[/h2]
Crowd tactics
Clear the remote town hard mode without using any buff spirits
Elite tactics
A tower receives more than 10 buffs at the same time
Solid backing
The life limit of any slime queen exceeds 1 million
Training master
Manually train any tower over level 30 in one battle
Offensive tactics
Complete the remote town hard mode without building SwampTower, SummonTower, Flamethrower, WaterTower, CorrosionTower, shieldTower, Scarecrows, and TeleportationTower



[h2]New core card[/h2]
Tower core
Remove all buff spirits, all building attack +265%, maxHP +432%, Range +62%, the number of attacks drops to 1, every time the number of attacks drops by 1, it attacks +25%.
Stable core
Buff spirits no longer have a random range, fixed to a larger and more comprehensive coverage area, but the building cost is increased by 100%.
Demon Core
Queen Slime's MaxHP is +703%, but her defense is -250, and the bonus of increasing her MaxHP is greatly increased.
Training core
Next, you will not be able to obtain experience upgrades (you can manually train and upgrade), but the number of souls obtained will +100%.
Offensive core
The attack of all towers is +62%, but the MaxHP is -50%.
Balance core
Get a common card to start the game


[h2]New random items[/h2]
remote town:
Seal - Vampire
super arrow tower
Seal - Anti-injury
Barbarian Kingdom:
Seal - Resurrection
shield
super meteorite tower
Frozen Castle:
super ice tower
Seal-Charm
super laser cannon


illustrate:
Super Tower: Occupies an area of 9 grids. Each time the consumable slime arrives, it will maintain operation for a period of time. It can receive buff bonuses or be destroyed by enemies. The resurrection time is longer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133039/d71b76fb320927ae3025eb9e06ec294c8fbf0706.png[/img]


[h2]New changes[/h2]
Buildings can now be destroyed in normal mode
Minimum resurrection time 0->10 seconds

Resurrection Spirit: Resurrection time reduction rate 10% -> 20%
Ice Tower: Extra Hit Rate +30%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43133039/5c82d269ead135de1721d6af43af7360f9986ae4.png[/img]

notes.title: February 25, 2023 Update Notes
notes.content:
Change:
1. External reinforcement of all towers:
Limits: Lower upgrade fees and remove pre-condition restrictions

2. The maximum resurrection time limit of all towers cannot exceed 30s, the formula is (10 + level * 2) * resurrection spirit reduction percentage

3. When all towers change colors due to upgrades, they get fixed attribute improvements:
Maximum hp boost: current level*50
Defense improvement: current level*1

4. Fire Slime
Gold Fire: Duration 40s->60s
Green Fire: Duration 10s->20s

5. Frozen Slime
Ice Guardian: Cooldown 120s->80s and restore 5000hp

6. Ground Slime
Earth Reflexion: Cooldown 120s -> 80s
Earth Revive: fixed recovery every 5s -> every 5s according to the maximum life percentage recovery, maximum 5000hp

7. LordGod Slime
Healing Light: The upper limit of single recovery is 5000

8. Scarecrow
dodge 0%->25%

9. Arrow Tower
Bullet existence time 2s->5s
Attack range 320->380
Number of Attacks 3->4

Bug fixes:
Thunder slime dodge will exceed 90%.
Yeti bullets miss their target.
Part of the damage is lost at 5x speed.

notes.title: Optimize update & bug repair
notes.content:
change:
1. In addition to first Slime, each queen increases the upper limit: 0-> 10.
2. Correct training price, part of the part of the experience during training will reduce the purple soul consumption.
3. The value of the entry is displayed to remove the vague description.
4. Add the upper limit of the level in the display entry.
5. External reinforcement plus point display upper limit level.
6. Rites of Scarecrow:
(1) Level 1: increased experience sharing rate 40 %-> The counterattack rate increases by 25%
(2) Level 2: Damage +125 %-> Damage+75%
7. Strawman's basic value modification: Basic experience sharing rate 20 %-> 40%

BUG fix:
1. Five times speed UI display bug.
2. The abnormal state may trigger the mobs that cannot be killed.
3. There is no sound when the volume bar is held halfway.
4. Trial mode cover UI position in the third level.
5. Frozen Slim <Skills: Ice Missile> Upgrade Unlock Condition BUG

notes.title: Development plans for the next few weeks
notes.content:
1. More map random locations: global attack bonus, global defense bonus, global life bonus, more types of graves, shields, etc.
2. Attach a certain reward to the destructible random objects, positive or negative.
3. There are more types of relics in terms of mechanism, not for the type of a single tower.
4. Novice guide level.
5. The description of each entry is optimized.
6. Added descriptions and biographies of various adventurers to the Adventurer's Illustrated Book.
